value.title: Marc-Aurèle de Foy Suzor-Coté
value.extract: Marc-Aurèle de Foy Suzor-Coté (French pronunciation: [maʁk oʁɛl də fwa syzɔʁ kɔte]; born Hypolite Wilfrid Marcaurèle Côté; April 6, 1869 – January 29, 1937) was a French Canadian painter and sculptor. He was one of the first native-born Canadian artists whose works were directly influenced by French Impressionism and Post-Impressionism.
